terra.problem: The claims that Moses is Israel's leader and Aaron is his brother and a priest need references outside this passage.
The text says the man was brought to the whole congregation, but does not say the whole crowd was standing.
The claim about Joshua and Caleb being spies who trusted God needs a reference outside this passage.
The claim that Eleazar is Aaron's son needs a reference outside this passage.
The passage does not say that nobody guessed or rushed.
The mention of sin offerings earlier in Numbers 15 needs a reference outside this passage.
The claim about pomegranates on clothing elsewhere in the Bible needs a reference.
Papa says he has a finger, but he is a cookie stamper who uses his mustache as hands.

Promising the baker will get it next time assumes a future result Papa cannot know.
